title: Centene, Two Maps
headline_html: Centene: back office and front office.
sub: Two Sales Navigator maps for one account: the people who run claims, appeals and shared services, and the people who run member services, the contact centers and workforce management. Every name checked against Salesforce and live-verified this week.
legend_html: In Salesforce: Intradiem already has a record for this person; they stay on the map because they run part of the operation. Same name elsewhere in Salesforce: a record with this name exists at another company.
md_title: # Front-office map build sheets, Nate's six
md_intro: Each sheet is one new Sales Navigator Relationship Map (cap 30). Build top-down: the customer operations executive, then the leaders of contact center operations, workforce management and service technology, then the directors under them. Reporting lines are inferred from titles; confirm each card in Sales Navigator as it is added.

account_notes.Centene - Back Office: Corporate operations run under the EVP & Chief Operating Officer (Susan Smith); plan-level COOs run their own health plans. Corporate function VPs are placed under the corporate COO. Appeals & grievances leadership (a quarter of the Jul 26 operations ICP list) did not surface in the data index for Centene; search 'Appeals' and 'Grievances' directly in Sales Navigator. Amy Weiser (was Director of Operations at UnitedHealthcare, a known Intradiem contact) joined Centene in May 2026 as Vice President, Medicare Market, Midwest (https://www.linkedin.com/in/amyweiser1). Market P&L seat, not back-office ICP, so she stays off the sequence; she is a warm door for Nate into Centene Medicare operations (Dan Clark's line).
account_notes.Centene - Front Office: Contact centers sit under the corporate COO (Colleen Askvig) with plan-level COOs running their own member services; Fidel Ligsay's line is Health Net Federal Services. Centene's front office already has Stars wave-one names in a live sequence, so check the collision flag before adding anyone from this map to outreach.
